_comment: Voice settings per speaker, used by tools/tts.py. A speaker is 'captain' or a puppy id.
provider: edge (Microsoft voices, free) or openai (needs OPENAI_API_KEY).
Child voices: the file is made slower and at a changed pitch, and the game plays it faster by 'playback'
with the pitch not preserved. This raises the pitch and the timbre together, like a child's voice.
pace: the final speed after the speed-up (1 = normal). Values chosen by measuring pitch and an audio-model age estimate (dev/voice_lab.py).

openai_instructions.captain: Voice: a real 9-year-old Israeli boy, bright and full of energy, like the dubbed voice of a kid hero in an animated TV show for young children. Speak Hebrew with a native Israeli accent. Speak slowly and clearly. Read exactly the given text. The niqqud shows the correct pronunciation.
openai_instructions.puppy: Voice: a real 6-year-old Israeli child playing a cute cartoon puppy: bouncy, excited and happy. Speak Hebrew with a native Israeli accent. Speak slowly. Read exactly the given text. The niqqud shows the correct pronunciation.
